case_type_reason: The supply arithmetic needs the astronaut's body weight, which is not public, and the flow data of the cohort are published only as aggregate counts and figures.
title: ISS internal jugular vein thrombosis: enoxaparin stock stretched until apixaban arrived

input_data.use: Stock (20 vials of 300 mg), dose per kg, the day-33 reduction and the day-42 switch

documented_outcome.quote: Approximately 2 months into an International Space Station mission, obstructive left internal jugular venous thrombosis was suspected in an astronaut during an ultrasound examination that was performed as part of a vascular research study. The astronaut reported no headache or worsening of the facial plethora that is common in conditions of weightlessness.
the dose was reduced to 1 mg per kilogram once daily after 33 days to extend therapy until oral apixaban could be delivered to the space station with a supply spacecraft.
a limited pharmacy in which long-term anticoagulation is not supported, syringes are a limited commodity, and drawing liquids from vials is a significant challenge because of surface-tension effects.

Furthermore, stagnant or reverse flow in the IJV was observed in 6 crew members (55%) on approximate flight day 50. Notably, 1 crew member was found to have an occlusive IJV thrombus, and a potential partial IJV thrombus was identified in another crew member retrospectively.

onset_relative_to_data: Thrombosis found about 2 months into the mission (flight day 50 in the cohort paper) by a research ultrasound, without symptoms. Day 0 of the regimen file is the diagnosis.

expected_product_output.output: A supply warning that 20 x 300 mg of enoxaparin at 1.5 mg/kg/d does not last until the next resupply for the crewman's weight, and a prompt for the weight when it is missing (no default weight, rule 5). The documented response is a dose reduction on day 33 and resupply of apixaban by day 42.

expected_product_output.role: Documented diagnosis by ultrasound read by radiologists on Earth. With no symptoms, the product has no trigger of its own; the case is not a detection test.

expected_product_output.kit_map: No anticoagulation-reversal agent on board at diagnosis (documented); the kit map should show it as not available here.

is_not: Not individual flow or ultrasound data (restricted). Not a protocol: the letter describes one decision made with specialists on the ground.
